catalog_flag.admission: Optional boolean validated; true dispatches exactly one existing readSavedCatalogSnapshot and assigns its unchanged envelope to packet.catalog_snapshot.
catalog_flag.F651_compatible: Packet itself is observer input: catalog_snapshot.private_evidence.snapshot has existing F616/F651 envelope; no remapping or re-aging.

snapshot_binding.producer_pin: Original snapshot implementation pin compared to admitted current artifact pin. Other implementation is explicit CATALOG_OTHER_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_CURRENT_PROOF, not native current proof.
snapshot_binding.clocks: Original received_ts/saved_ts/receipt_id/body_sha256/source_event_ts:null preserved; observed_ts is separate lookup clock; receive age not reset.
snapshot_binding.bounds: One retained record, <=2000 rows, parsed-body bytes<=2097152/full-record<=1900000 and digest/schema/route/family/receipt/clock order checks; no current globalN/CORE claim.

Unicode.basis: Observer returns snapshot body unchanged; no symbol filter, case conversion or ASCII gate on catalog rows. ROOT case checks Chinese symbol survives.
Unicode.known_selection_limit: CLI candidate_instrument_ids for the two explicit requested IDs retain ASCII pattern. This does not filter catalog/checked fallback; this PASS is for declared two known IDs, not new Unicode-ID admission extension.

query_budget.enforcement: DB adapter increments attempts before fetch and refuses calls>=16; shared native LOOKUP remains500R/30W/max10day. Query cap is not proof of actual D1 row cost; original shared ledger/unknown/reserves still apply.
query_budget.guard_cap_reservation: Shared native reserve insert+PK readback and final UPDATE+PK readback =4, no duplication of executor/run/original business reads in card observer.

inflight.basis: Actual captured executor object reused, never fabricated released/completed. When its live run differs, live run get returns null without native read; scope.live_run_outside_scope_not_read=true, while selected known_run is retained separately.

selected_originals.basis: One SENT original prioritized; no SENT permits <=2. Analysis requests outside prefetched selected original map throw instead of extra native reads.

wave_outcome.basis: Explicit flags honored; retained wave at most1 with same_wave_id diagnostic, no substitute for original.next_wave. Outcome gets journal/signal then outcome<=3 only after same-original delivery binding; no bound SENT =>0 outcome native reads.

read_clocks.basis: selector_observed_ts follows first executor/resources reads; executor_snapshot_ts preserves that selector clock and scope flags executor/selected-run reuse. Nested observer read_started_ts is sub-observer start, not a fresh executor/run fetch. Original persisted source/run clocks remain unchanged.
read_clocks.limit: No per-PK transport time interval or atomic multi-key snapshot claimed.
